nodes.speaker: Jess
nodes.text: No signal. Zero bars. Is this a bank or a bunker.

nodes.speaker: Jess
nodes.text: Tried it. Tried the door. Tried holding it up like a lighter at a concert. Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Jess
nodes.text: My mum. I've missed the bus twice and she thinks I'm at school. Technically I'm at a bank, which is basically maths.

nodes.speaker: Jess
nodes.text: They took my phone. My phone. Not my purse. My phone.
